Platform estimates are shown in USD and are not binding quotations. Implementation, migration, custom work, hosting, usage and applicable taxes are confirmed separately before work begins. Annual display is 12 × the monthly estimate; no discount is implied.

What moves
the price.

The platform estimate is the smaller part of most projects. These are the factors that decide the rest.

Number of workflows

One reviewed workflow is a modest project. Six connected ones are a programme. We price in stages so you can stop after any of them.

Data you bring with you

Clean, current records are quick to import. Years of inconsistent spreadsheets need review, mapping and a rehearsed migration.

Integrations

Each connected system needs access, testing and a plan for when its provider changes something. Some are straightforward; some are not.

People to train

Two coordinators need a different plan from forty staff in three locations. Training and handover are scoped separately.

Running costs

Hosting, messaging fees, AI model usage and support continue after launch. We list them with their likely range so there are no surprises.

How decisions are made

Projects with one decision maker move faster than those with an approval chain of five. We will tell you honestly if timing is at risk.

Some work deserves
a proper conversation.

Websites, custom applications, automation, marketing and enablement are quoted against an agreed brief, deliverables and handover.

Do these prices include implementation?+

No. The platform estimate and the implementation scope are separate so you can see what you are paying for.

Are all prices in dollars?+

Yes. Public estimates are displayed in USD. Taxes and any invoicing arrangements are confirmed in your quotation.

Is there an annual discount?+

No discount is shown here. The annual toggle displays the monthly reference multiplied by twelve.

Can you give us a fixed project quote?+

We can quote an agreed scope after reviewing the requirements, dependencies and acceptance criteria.
